[u][b]The Secretly Cute Senpai Werewolf Oppai Spy![/b][/u]
Race: Werewolf
Code Name: Horde
Third Year at Espiona Girls' Academy
Assigned Class: Wolfard
Club: Spy Track & Field Club

Erza is a third-year student at Espiona Spy Academy, and a werewolf. She serves as the overseer of the Wolfard class, which specializes in assassination and combat.

Werewolves are said to be a race born for battle, possessing exceptional physical abilities and overwhelming strength in close combat. Erza in particular excels in speed and relentless attacks, to the point that those who face her feel as if they are being attacked by a pack rather than a single opponent. Wolves are known for their strong sense of family, and as a class leader, Erza is deeply trusted by her students. However, her two top underclassmen each have very strong personalities, and she seems to struggle with handling them.

Because of her sharp features and dignified presence, she is extremely popular among the female students, to the point that she even has a fan club. Her appeal lies in the combination of being a leader while also giving off a lone wolf aura.…However, her true self is actually gentle, domestic, and quite feminine. She has continued to act the part expected of her so as not to disappoint those who admire her.

When she first encounters the protagonist, they spar, and she quickly recognizes his skill. As fellow specialists in close combat, they hit it off and become close. She develops feelings for him as someone she can confide in and speak honestly with.

Her codename is “Horde,” referring to her combat style of fighting like a pack. Her ability as a spy reflects her position at the top of Wolfard, specializing in close-quarters combat using martial techniques. Even when outnumbered, she is capable of turning the situation in her favor.

Her boobs are U-cups, with a “Lone Rocket, downward-sloping” shape. She used to think they were a bit too large, but after learning that the protagonist is a big fan of breasts, she has reconsidered her opinion. Her specialty in honey traps is an aggressive “escort wolf” style approach. Werewolves have a courtship behavior on full moon nights known as “okuri-ōkami,” where they escort and pursue their partner. Since she is naturally shy and reserved, she uses that trait to build momentum and make her move.

She usually wears glasses, but they are purely for appearance. Because she is often seen as intimidating, she wears them to soften her image. Her hobbies include cooking and collecting fluffy stuffed animals. Her specialties are close combat and running.

Her mother, Glenda, is a teacher at the academy who instructs combat and dungeon training.
Unlike her daughter, she embodies the stereotypical werewolf personality, bold, rough, and battle-loving. At home, Erza handles most of the household chores, and despite their differences, they have a good relationship.
